Judgment And Award Dated:7.11.2012 Passed In Mvc
No.439/2011 On The File Of Ii Additional Senior Civil
Judge And Additional Mact-6, Chitradurga, Partly
Allowing The Claim Petition For Compensation And
Seeking Enhancement Of Compensation.
 This Appeal Coming On For Final Hearing This
Day, The Court Delivered The Following:
 Judgment
There is no representation on behalf of the appellant.
The learned counsel for respondent No.2 is present.
Though the appeal is pending since 2013, the learned counsel for the appellant has not shown any interest in prosecuting the matter.
Hence, it is evident that the appellant is not interested in prosecuting the matter by giving instructions to his counsel.
Considering these aspects, the appeal stands dismissed for non-prosecution.

Sd/-
